purpose.zh: 练核心，身体变长时腰也不塌
purpose.en: Build your core so your lower back stays up as your body stretches out.

text.zh: 双手撑住不动，两只脚一起往后滑再收回
text.en: Keep your hands planted and slide both feet back, then pull them in

text.zh: 手肘和膝盖基本伸直，身体整体一起动。
text.en: Keep your elbows and knees nearly straight and move your body as one piece.

text.zh: 只滑到能控制的距离，腰别塌。
text.en: Slide only as far as you can control without letting your back sag.

commonErrors.en: Sliding too far and losing control.

cautions.zh: 先能不疼地做直臂平板再练，先做 1 组 4 次
cautions.en: Make sure a straight-arm plank is pain-free first, and start with one set of 4 reps.
Stop if your wrists, shoulders or lower back hurt.

changes: 名字「长杠杆回收」是术语，改「直臂滑盘前后滑」（英文不变）
purpose 去掉「抗伸展」；cue2「胸廓和骨盆一起动」改「身体整体一起动」
口令按 0.7 s 缩短（收回/Pull in）
flags: 派生把顶点算成 ≥0.8 s 判为 rep_hold，但 spec 轨道真正的静止只有约 0.4 s（注释/关键帧），若按实际应为 rep_updown，请确认
